At the time, fans wondered if Travis was hinting at a connection to the game.

source_caption_text:
Travis Scott may have teased GTA 6 YEARS ago, and most people completely missed it. 👀🎮

At the end of his “2000 EXCURSION” music video, look closely at the car’s license plate. It reads “GTA 6” and it even has a Florida-style design, fitting the game’s setting in Vice City, Rockstar’s fictional version of Miami.

At the time, fans wondered if Travis was hinting at a connection to the game. Since then, he’s only fueled the speculation by tagging Rockstar Games on Instagram and posting cryptic messages that fans have tried to connect to GTA 6. 👀

Now, things have gotten even more interesting. Travis has released “RHYNO,” a single connected to the upcoming Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album 🔥

Was Travis quietly dropping hints before anyone knew what was coming, or are fans reading too much into it?
Coincidence or one of the biggest GTA 6 easter eggs hiding in plain sight? Let me know what you think in the comments. 👇
